title: Crossref hormuz share z>1 -> TTF 7d
hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] Crossref hormuz share of all publications (control-normalized) 8-week z-score > 1 leads TTF gas futures returns by 7 days (+) as chokepoint attention prices European supply risk; trade long TTF=F 7d [research.hormuz.crossref_share -> finance.TTF=F.log_return] (parent: R2-0031)
message: Supported weakly: crossref hormuz share leads TTF by +1wk r=0.43 (perm p=0.018, Bonferroni 0.054, n=81 weekly); contemporaneous r=0.02; daily 1d long rule negative in-sample (8 trades, hit 0.375), OOS 2 trades; actionability 0.58

trade_idea.entry_rule: research.hormuz.crossref_share rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long TTF=F next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.
